Transaction and block dispatch management with staging lanes, pools, maps, and transaction queues.

# Purpose
`fd_rdisp.c` implements the runtime state and operations for a block and transaction dispatcher. It defines the internal record types `fd_rdisp_txn_t`, `fd_rdisp_blockinfo_t`, and `fd_rdisp_unstaged_t`, then builds the dispatcher state in `fd_rdisp_t`. The file uses generated pool, map, and singly linked list helpers from the template code in `fd_pool.c`, `fd_slist.c`, and `fd_map_chain.c` to manage transaction records, block records, block lookup by tag, and four staging lanes.

The public functions manage the full life cycle of dispatcher state: [`fd_rdisp_align`](<#fd_rdisp_align>), [`fd_rdisp_footprint`](<#fd_rdisp_footprint>), [`fd_rdisp_new`](<#fd_rdisp_new>), and [`fd_rdisp_join`](<#fd_rdisp_join>) set up memory and attach to it; [`fd_rdisp_add_block`](<#fd_rdisp_add_block>), [`fd_rdisp_remove_block`](<#fd_rdisp_remove_block>), [`fd_rdisp_abandon_block`](<#fd_rdisp_abandon_block>), [`fd_rdisp_promote_block`](<#fd_rdisp_promote_block>), [`fd_rdisp_demote_block`](<#fd_rdisp_demote_block>), and [`fd_rdisp_rekey_block`](<#fd_rdisp_rekey_block>) manage block state and lane placement; [`fd_rdisp_add_txn`](<#fd_rdisp_add_txn>), [`fd_rdisp_get_next_ready`](<#fd_rdisp_get_next_ready>), and [`fd_rdisp_complete_txn`](<#fd_rdisp_complete_txn>) manage transaction insertion, dispatch, and completion. The file also provides [`fd_rdisp_suggest_staging_lane`](<#fd_rdisp_suggest_staging_lane>) to choose a lane for a block and [`fd_rdisp_staging_lane_info`](<#fd_rdisp_staging_lane_info>) to report lane usage.
